# Failure & Retry Handling Checklist: P-RF01 — Multimodal Capture

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements quality of P-RF01's failure, retry, and offline-handling behavior (FR-007, FR-009, FR-010, related edge cases and success criteria) — the area with the most intricate, interacting requirements in this spec.
**Created**: 2026-10-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is retry behavior specified distinctly for each failure source (recognition failure vs. the entry-creation call itself failing), or only as one combined case? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec define what re-invoking "retry" actually does — automatically resubmits Save, or requires a fresh user confirmation? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the retention window for locally-held captured audio/image specified — does it survive app backgrounding/kill, or only the active modal session? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for a user who denies microphone/camera permission and later grants it via OS settings while the modal is still open? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a maximum retry attempt count or cooldown specified for repeated Save failures, or is retry left unbounded? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "zero usable text" (Edge Cases) defined precisely enough to be distinguishable from low-confidence-but-nonempty recognized text, which must NOT fail per the resolved clarification? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the offline-detection method left implementation-independent while still specific enough to verify ("before any network call is attempted")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK008 Is a timeout threshold specified for when in-flight transcription/OCR should be treated as failed rather than merely slow? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the three failure messages (permission denied, recognition failure, offline) required to be distinct and failure-specific, or could one generic message satisfy all as currently worded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do the audio-failure acceptance criteria (US2 AC4) and photo-failure acceptance criteria (US3 AC4) specify equivalent retry/retention guarantees, or does one modality carry stronger wording than the other? [Consistency, Spec §US2 AC4 vs US3 AC4]
- [ ] CHK011 Does "network timeout" in US2 AC4 refer to the same condition as FR-010's offline-blocking requirement, or a distinct scenario (connectivity present but the request still times out)? [Ambiguity, Spec §US2 AC4 vs FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the double-tap/in-flight-save safeguard stated as a testable functional requirement consistent with FR-006's "exactly one persisted entry" guarantee, or does it remain only in Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions vs FR-006]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the Capture Session's "ephemeral, discarded on abandonment" description (Key Entities) conflict with FR-009's requirement that captured audio/image survive a failure for retry? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities vs FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-004 ("0% of failures result in lost source material") be objectively verified without a defined retention-duration requirement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-005 ("100% of offline save attempts blocked before any network call") be verified without a specified method for detecting offline state? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for connectivity being restored while an offline-blocked Save message is still displayed — auto-clear vs. manual retry? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for the device going offline mid-sequence, after recognition succeeds but before the entry-creation call completes? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a second permission denial after the user already saw and dismissed the explanatory message once? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements specified for how long the plain loading indicator (FR-007) may run before the system itself times out the recognition attempt? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK020 Is the Save-idempotency assumption (disabled while a save is in flight) validated against a concrete functional requirement, or does it remain an unvalidated assumption absent from the Functional Requirements list? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the OS permission-prompt timing relative to tab activation (FR-004) documented as a stated assumption, or left implicit and dependent on platform behavior? [Assumption, Spec §FR-004]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
